prompt.project_info: An airy lifestyle portrait built around an open timber doorway, soft morning sun, and muted sage homewear.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with thick dark waves over one shoulder, eyes gently closed, and a peaceful expression. She wears a muted sage textured short-sleeve knit top with coordinating relaxed high-waisted satin trousers.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-length vertical doorway portrait. One hand touches the timber doorframe and the other rests loosely in her hair; the garden beyond is softly blurred. Keep the composition unposed and remove text, logos, and branded details.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm natural morning sunlight from behind at approximately 4300K, soft shadows across the covered outfit, authentic skin texture, and a hint of wind in the hair.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame camera with a 50mm lens at f/2.8, 9:16 vertical crop, shallow natural depth of field, soft highlight roll-off, muted sage-and-amber palette, fine film grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Vertical photorealistic lifestyle portrait of an adult woman with thick flowing dark waves over her shoulders, standing in a softly illuminated timber doorway filled with warm natural sunlight. She wears a muted sage textured short-sleeve knit top and coordinating relaxed high-waisted satin trousers. One hand touches the doorframe and the other rests softly in her hair, eyes gently closed, serene expression, airy garden bokeh behind her, authentic skin texture, soft shadows, realistic depth of field, no text or branding.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, lingerie, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed hands
